decisive_steps.step: Universal upper bound via the equivariant test map and its associated vector bundle.
decisive_steps.checked: Verified continuity of the sign-integral test map, including at constant affine functions, by dominated convergence. Its transformation laws give the stated bundle over RP^d×RP^d, whose nonzero top Stiefel–Whitney class forces a zero. For n=2^{s−1}, the coefficient of x^{3n−4}y^{3n−2} is indeed odd and survives when d=3n−2. A zero gives four positive-measure sign regions and therefore two proper nonparallel hyperplanes.

decisive_steps.step: Construction of 2n−2 positive-definite symmetric matrices with no common bilinear zero on nonzero vectors.
decisive_steps.checked: Checked the general polynomial argument. Nonzero polynomial factors vanishing jointly at all 2k−2 evaluation points must split those roots into complementary subsets of size k−1. Their real coefficient vectors have positive inner product, while the specified skew matrix gives a^T K b equal to the difference of root sums, which is odd. The first two bilinear equations consequently force both real and imaginary parts of conjugate(alpha)·beta to vanish, a contradiction. The real matrices are symmetric, and shifting by multiples of the included identity makes them positive definite without changing their common bilinear zero set.

decisive_steps.step: Gaussian lower bound in dimension 3n−3 and exclusion of smaller dimensions.
decisive_steps.checked: The chosen means force every common bisector to have zero offset and normal supported in the last n coordinates. For each Gaussian, quartering by two such hyperplanes forces covariance u^T A_i v=0, contradicting the matrix construction. All Gaussian covariance matrices are positive definite. Verified upward monotonicity using absolutely continuous coordinate projections and pullback of the equipartitioning hyperplanes.

decisive_steps.step: Exact finite computational checks supporting the construction and upper-bound coefficient.
decisive_steps.checked: Read agents/agent_1/scratchpad.py and reran it unchanged through a wrapper. It passed with 1, 10, and 1716 complementary root splits for s=3,4,5; respectively 6,14,30 positive-definite covariance matrices in dimensions 9,21,45; and the reported surviving Euler monomials. contract.form: A complete answer must give an explicit exact formula for D_s valid for every integer s ≥ 3, identifying the least dimension in which the stated simultaneous four-way equipartition is always possible.
contract.not_enough: Bounds, a range of possible dimensions, a conjectural or conditional formula, or values for only some s do not settle the question. A proposed dimension must be shown both to suffice for every allowed collection of measures and to be minimal.

definite_reason: It gives an explicit exact value of D_s for every integer s ≥ 3; equality with D_s asserts both sufficiency and minimality.
